python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('materials_thermal_dataset.csv')
exclude = ['bulk_modulus_vrh', 'band_gap_ev', 'material_id', 'formula_pretty']
feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in exclude]
print('Sample feature column names (first 30):')
for c in feature_cols[:30]:
    print(' ', c)
print('...')
print('Last 10:')
for c in feature_cols[-10:]:
    print(' ', c)
print('Total:', len(feature_cols))
"
